newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah drops in London on false rumours.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah drops in London on false rumours.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah tumbled against the dollar in the evening on false rumours of riots in Jakarta, dealers said.
They said spot rupiah fell to 2,445 at 1040 GMT in London trading, compared with the Jakarta close at 2,433.40/33.75.
One U.S. bank dealer said there were rumours in London that a police station was set on fire in the capital.
Police in Jakarta said there were no reports of violence in the city.

However rumours of trouble persisted through the day as tens of thousands of supporters of the minority United Development Party (PPP) thronged the streets during the ongoing general election campaign.
One Singapore dealer said the over-reaction by London players may have resulted from jitters in the Thai baht which was rattled by offshore attacks through the day.
Dealers said London players remained biddish on the dollar but some expected a quick rupiah recovery when the rumours died down.
